answer: Admit identities through a narrow inlet: a new agent may take only 2 paid tasks in its first epoch, and its quota doubles only after each task scores 2 or more, capped at 32. Each epoch the chain measures the delta between claimed and re-verified completions; a gap over 10% freezes the identity and burns 30 POA of its 70-POA bond. Tasks leave from a jetty queue in round-robin order, one per identity per pass, so ten fakes wait ten passes. Ten clones need ten bonds, ten ladders and ten audits, so cost climbs per fake while the chain verifies scores, bonds and queue order from its ledger.
